items.title: 63519_Wild Bill Davison oral history interview
items.q: Ann always seems to get more money out of Germany than any other place I've worked

ctx.x: Well, Ann had always said - I made

those two string albums for Columbia and, by some fluke I got the arrangement - not only got the arrangement but I got the scores as well and I carried them around from place to place with Ann, my wife and I kept saying to Ann - for God's sake - that heavy box -- let's get rid of that thing and she insisted we keep it. So, when I got to Denmark, I was talking to a big record company and I told them about this; they said, my God, why don't you get those arrangements - send them over here - and we'll make a record…
